metadata.title: Android Release Action Items
metadata.purpose: Authoritative execution-ranked backlog for completing Android QA and a controlled Google Play release.
metadata.rank_policy: Rank is authoritative. Independent owner or infrastructure preparation may start early, but completion is recorded in ranked dependency order.

external_gates.title: Owner and system access for emulator provisioning
external_gates.description: The Lenovo host must expose usable VT-x/KVM, the required SDK components and AVDs, authorized OPPO ADB access, and standard Git repository/status/identity/worktree commands from the Number Garden directory.
external_gates.completion_criteria: Every check in docs/runbooks/android-release/preflight.md is evidenced without recording a device serial or other secret.
external_gates.next_action: Use the provisioned host, authorized OPPO, and three cold-booted AVDs for scoped release QA.

external_gates.title: Owner approval of source artwork
external_gates.description: The owner must select and explicitly approve the source launcher and splash artwork before native assets are replaced.
external_gates.completion_criteria: The approved source files, review evidence, and exact NG-AND-014 acknowledgement are recorded.
external_gates.blocker: No approved final source artwork is recorded.

gpt-5.6-luna.routing: SDK and AVD mechanics, scripted QA preparation, repeated commands, asset checks, and evidence normalization.

gpt-5.6-terra.routing: Gradle diagnosis, device and WebView QA, policy-link implementation, artwork integration, signing configuration, AAB validation, and Play-delivered QA.

gpt-5.6-sol.routing: Arithmetic correctness, analytics consent, cross-cutting sign-off, Play policy, release freeze, remediation, and consequential owner gates.

next_actions: Review the concurrent NG-AND-001 and NG-AND-002 worker results and integrate them in rank order.
Review the NG-AND-003 analysis, but do not authorize implementation until NG-AND-001 is integrated.
Finish NG-AND-009 app install/debug verification on the three provisioned AVDs.
Await separate owner acknowledgements for NG-AND-012, NG-AND-013, and NG-AND-014.

items.summary: Stabilize the deterministic curriculum harness
items.description: Reproduce the current quick-drop Tens visibility failure and reconcile it with the prior run that passed that check but failed a later multiplication visibility assertion. Determine whether the defect is product behavior, harness timing, or both; add deterministic coverage and change only canonical source/tests as warranted.
items.completion_criteria: Repeated current-HEAD runs reach `PASS: Number Garden curriculum checks`; affected generated copies are rebuilt/synced; failure/retest details are in the QA report.

next_actions: Resume after the usage-window reset, run the new deterministic headless harness repeatedly, review concurrency coverage, and commit only if all checks pass.

items.summary: Resolve aggregate Android instrumentation dependency failure
items.description: Fix the Kotlin stdlib duplicate-class conflict in `:capacitor-cordova-android-plugins:checkDebugAndroidTestDuplicateClasses`, or isolate it as a non-app test-variant limitation with explicit owner acceptance and a documented safe command boundary.
items.completion_criteria: Aggregate `connectedDebugAndroidTest` passes, or the owner accepts a documented isolation; `:app:connectedDebugAndroidTest` still passes.

next_actions: Resume only to emit and persist the schema-valid final worker result, then review the scoped commit after NG-AND-001 integration.

items.summary: Implement parent/guardian analytics consent and withdrawal
items.description: Prevent `gtag.js`, base configuration, and analytics requests before consent. Add a persistent, revocable parent/guardian choice in Settings; retain the single tag ID and keep Tutorial analytics-free.
items.completion_criteria: Cold launch and declined consent generate no analytics request; granted consent enables reviewed events; withdrawal stops future analytics; storage/migration/accessibility tests pass.

next_actions: After NG-AND-001 is integrated, start a fresh implementation worktree from the current checkpoint and apply the reviewed consent design with deterministic coverage.

items.summary: Audit Android WebView traffic for every consent state
items.description: Inspect cold launch, declined consent, granted consent, gameplay, withdrawal, and offline paths. Record hosts, request timing, headers/payload categories, storage effects, and console/logcat behavior without recording secrets or device serials.
items.completion_criteria: QA report contains reproducible Network/console/IndexedDB evidence and confirms shipped behavior for each path.

blockers: NG-AND-003 is incomplete.
next_actions: Audit all consent and offline traffic states after NG-AND-003 is integrated.

items.summary: Finalize and publish privacy policy; add in-app link
items.description: Replace draft placeholders with audited facts, approve the text, publish it at an owner-controlled public HTTPS URL, and add an accessible link in the app and later the Play listing.
items.completion_criteria: Public URL is live; policy matches traffic evidence; in-app link is keyboard/TalkBack accessible and works online without making gameplay network-dependent.

blockers: NG-AND-004 is incomplete and owner publication approval is required.
next_actions: Prepare the audited draft and pause at the NG-AND-005 owner runbook.

items.summary: Complete remaining OPPO arithmetic and interaction matrix
items.description: Finish resets, queued-motion interruption, hold boundaries, progression, rapid taps/input locks, zero/empty places, level layouts, stationary multiplicand, Pull All stop boundaries, operation language/themes, and complete Settings/persistence flows.
items.completion_criteria: Every required addition, subtraction, multiplication, and shared-flow row is Pass or has a tracked defect/retest; evidence is recorded.

blockers: NG-AND-001 is incomplete.
next_actions: Complete the remaining OPPO matrix after the deterministic harness is stable.

items.summary: Complete lifecycle, persistence, offline, and network QA
items.description: Test background/foreground, lock/unlock, reboot, process recovery, reset, explicit clear-data behavior on a permitted target, update persistence, airplane-mode cold launch, full offline flow, and graceful network/analytics failure.
items.completion_criteria: All lifecycle/persistence/offline rows pass on required targets with source/APK hashes, logs, and storage evidence.

blockers: NG-AND-003 and NG-AND-006 are incomplete.
next_actions: Run the serialized OPPO lifecycle and network matrix when dependencies pass.

items.summary: Complete accessibility, layout, system UI, input, and audio QA
items.description: Cover TalkBack order/roles/live regions/dialog focus, keyboard navigation/occlusion, touch targets, contrast, font/display scaling, reduced motion, portrait/landscape, navigation modes/cutouts/edge-to-edge/fullscreen, silent mode, sound off/on, and interruption.
items.completion_criteria: All accessibility/system-UI/input/audio rows pass or have fixed and retested defects; no P0/P1 issue remains.

blockers: NG-AND-003 and NG-AND-006 are incomplete.
next_actions: Run the serialized OPPO accessibility and system-UI matrix when dependencies pass.

items.summary: Provision emulator tooling and acceleration
items.description: Install Android SDK Command-line Tools (or use SDK Manager), API 24/30/36 Google APIs images, and Pixel 2/5/6 AVDs. Provide `/dev/kvm` or another supported hardware-accelerated runner.
items.completion_criteria: All three required AVDs cold-boot without snapshots and can install/debug the app; configurations are recorded.

next_actions: Install and debug the app on each provisioned AVD, one emulator at a time, and record the configurations and results.

items.summary: Execute API 24, API 30, and API 36 emulator matrix
items.description: Repeat launch, arithmetic/high-risk interactions, lifecycle, offline, layout/navigation, accessibility smoke, and clean log capture on the required AVDs; record target-specific differences.
items.completion_criteria: Required emulator rows pass with configuration, WebView version, screenshots/logs, and reproducible defect records.

blockers: NG-AND-001 and NG-AND-009 are incomplete.
next_actions: Run one AVD at a time across API 24, 30, and 36.

items.summary: Close defects and obtain release-QA sign-off
items.description: For each failure, reproduce, add deterministic coverage, fix canonical source, build/sync, rerun affected browser/device/emulator targets, and refresh the QA report from the exact candidate source. Classify severity and document accepted lower risks.
items.completion_criteria: Harness and required matrix pass; aggregate test disposition is accepted; no P0/P1 defect is open; QA report names exact commit/hashes and owner-accepted lower risks.

blockers: NG-AND-001 through NG-AND-010 are incomplete.
next_actions: Review all evidence and close or explicitly accept every defect.

items.summary: Complete upload-key custody and backups
items.description: Put the existing upload-key password in an owner-controlled password manager, create and verify two encrypted keystore backups in separate owner-controlled locations, then remove the temporary plaintext handoff. Do not replace the existing key or expose its private path/material.
items.completion_criteria: Owner confirms password-manager entry, two recoverable encrypted backups, plaintext cleanup, and continued separation from the debug key.

blockers: Owner-controlled custody and backup work is required.
next_actions: Pause for the exact NG-AND-012 owner acknowledgement without collecting secret paths or values.

items.summary: Verify developer account and create the Play app
items.description: With explicit authorization, verify the Play developer account, create the app using immutable package `io.github.jdatta.numbergarden`, resolve any prior debug-key ownership prompt, enable Play App Signing, and determine whether the account has a closed-test requirement.
items.completion_criteria: App/package registration exists; Play App Signing and account testing requirements are recorded; no production submission occurs.

blockers: A just-in-time owner authorization and signed-in Play Console session are required.
next_actions: Request the exact NG-AND-013 acknowledgement before any Play Console mutation; pause for terms, identity, payment, private-key proof, or an unexpected ownership prompt.

items.summary: Approve source artwork and replace native placeholders
items.description: Approve Number Garden launcher/splash source art, generate all Android densities, and verify adaptive-icon masking, safe zones, backgrounds, light/dark behavior, and Android 12+ splash transition.
items.completion_criteria: Tracked native assets are deliberate and reviewed; real-device and emulator evidence passes; no placeholder remains.

blockers: The artwork_approval gate is unsatisfied.
next_actions: Prepare reviewable source-art proposals, then collect exact file/hash/background/rights approval before changing native assets.

items.summary: Complete Families, Data safety, access, ads, and IARC declarations
items.description: Use the implemented behavior and traffic audit to complete target ages 3–8/Families, all selected countries, Data safety, no-ads, no-IAP, unrestricted App access, category, and IARC answers. Recheck live rules at submission time.
items.completion_criteria: Saved Play declarations accurately match the shipped build, policy, and evidence; discrepancies are resolved before upload promotion.

blockers: NG-AND-004, NG-AND-005, and NG-AND-013 are incomplete.
next_actions: Recheck official Play requirements and prepare exact declarations from final evidence.

items.summary: Prepare approved Play listing and media
items.description: Produce the 512×512 icon, 1024×500 feature graphic, clean representative screenshots with alt text, title, short/full descriptions, support details, privacy URL, countries, and release notes. Do not reuse evidence screenshots with notification clutter.
items.completion_criteria: Every required listing field/asset is approved, policy-consistent, correctly sized, and ready in Play Console.

blockers: NG-AND-005 and NG-AND-014 are incomplete.
next_actions: Prepare copy and media; defer final screenshots until a signed candidate exists.

items.summary: Add secret-free signing wiring and release version
items.description: Configure release signing from ignored properties or CI environment variables, fail clearly when credentials are absent, keep debug builds unaffected, and deliberately set `versionName 3.1.0` with `versionCode 1` only for the first actual Play upload.
items.completion_criteria: Debug build/tests pass without secrets; authorized release build can consume external credentials; no secret/path is tracked or logged; version metadata is correct.

blockers: NG-AND-012 is incomplete.
next_actions: Implement secret-free signing and deliberate first-upload versioning after custody is confirmed.

items.summary: Build final baseline and freeze release-candidate commit
items.description: From a clean dependency install, rebuild/sync canonical web assets, run the full browser/native/device/emulator baseline after privacy, artwork, and version/signing changes, update hashes/evidence, and freeze one exact commit.
items.completion_criteria: Clean tracked worktree except approved user-local files; all gates pass; exact commit is named; no later code/asset/privacy/version mutation occurs without reopening QA.

blockers: NG-AND-011, NG-AND-014, NG-AND-015, and NG-AND-017 are incomplete.
next_actions: Create a clean, fully evidenced release-candidate freeze after all dependencies pass.

items.summary: Build and validate signed release AAB
items.description: Build `app-release.aab` with JDK 21 and the owner upload key; validate package, version, manifest, certificate, contents, signature, SHA-256, and absence of debug keys, local paths, properties, or secrets.
items.completion_criteria: AAB validation passes; hash and public upload-certificate fingerprint are recorded; artifact matches the frozen commit.

blockers: NG-AND-018 is incomplete; bundletool must be installed before this item.
next_actions: Install and record a current official bundletool version, then validate an AAB from the exact frozen commit.

items.summary: Upload to Internal testing and review Play analysis
items.description: With explicit authorization, upload the validated AAB, resolve Console validation, inspect App Bundle Explorer, and review the pre-launch report.
items.completion_criteria: Internal release is available to authorized testers and all Console/pre-launch findings are recorded and triaged.

blockers: NG-AND-013, NG-AND-015, NG-AND-016, and NG-AND-019 are incomplete; exact-artifact owner approval is required.
next_actions: Pause for scoped approval of the exact AAB SHA-256 and version before upload.

items.summary: Test the Play-delivered build
items.description: Install from the tester opt-in flow and repeat critical launch, offline, persistence/update, all operations, holds, Tutorial, sound, orientation/safe areas, analytics/privacy, accessibility, and signing/version checks.
items.completion_criteria: Critical matrix passes on the Play-signed artifact with store-delivery evidence; no sideloaded debug build is used as a substitute.

blockers: NG-AND-020 is incomplete.
next_actions: Test only the Play-delivered artifact after Internal testing is live.

items.summary: Complete any mandatory closed test and production-access application
items.description: Apply the Play Console requirement discovered for the owner account; if required, maintain the current tester count/duration, collect real feedback, document fixes, and apply for production access only after all gates pass.
items.completion_criteria: Console confirms the applicable testing requirement is satisfied or not required; feedback and fixes are documented; production access is granted if an application was required.

blockers: NG-AND-013 and NG-AND-020 are incomplete; Play Console applicability is unresolved.
next_actions: Record the live account requirement; complete or mark not applicable with evidence.

items.summary: Resolve pre-launch/test findings and version replacements correctly
items.description: Fix or explicitly accept lower-risk findings, reopen proportional QA, increment `versionCode` for every replacement bundle, rebuild/validate, and repeat affected Play testing.
items.completion_criteria: No release-blocking finding remains; accepted risks have owner approval; every uploaded replacement has a unique increasing version code and matching evidence.

blockers: NG-AND-020 through NG-AND-022 are incomplete; remediation applicability is unresolved.
next_actions: Resolve findings or mark not applicable; every app change repeats NG-AND-018 through NG-AND-021 with a higher versionCode.

items.summary: Archive release evidence and approve staged production rollout
items.description: Archive the release commit, AAB hash, public certificate fingerprint, QA report, policy/listing versions, and release notes. Obtain explicit owner approval, submit or stage rollout, and monitor Android vitals, crashes/ANRs, reviews, and policy messages.
items.completion_criteria: Archive is complete; owner approval is recorded; rollout is controlled and monitored; any stop/rollback criterion is acted on.

blockers: NG-AND-021 through NG-AND-023 are incomplete and fresh production approval is required.
next_actions: Archive exact release evidence and request a new production-specific approval.
